_about.en: Cycle I map tiles transcribed from scans (front = NNN.jpg, back = NNNb.jpg; h = special variant). symbols: counts for progress/titan/doom (Exploration box bottom-left: flame triangle = progress, skull triangle = doom; balloon bubble = titan), bools for bubbles. Extra keys: symbols.adversary = head-in-circle bubble, symbols.other = icons not in legend, arrow.river = winding-river icon on arrow, back = text on back of h-variants. factions = Local Faction icon bottom-right (yarn = Hornsworn, bull = Minoans, rhombus = Labyrinthians). Two arrows with the same dir/to = two separate arrows on the same edge (upper/lower). KNOSSOS.jpg is a duplicate scan of 027 front; column.jpg is not a map tile (pillar art, no data).
